title: Somewhat useful app disabled and made useless. Terrible!
body:
This WAS a useful app, I might have scored it 3 stars until recently, easy access to spreadsheets made in Google Sheets. Part of the loss of stars is problems with the service (needing to login to do office work, even unimportant personal things, certain incompatibility with the industry standard of Excel, irritates the hell out of me that dates and times can't be entered in the North American standards of MM/DD/YYYY and 12h/AM/PM respectively), part was the app being crippled compared to online (can Freeze Frames on the web, not in the app, the app is severely limited in creating and copying formats such as to fix the aforementioned date and time issues in display at least).

But lately Google has been threatening to REQUIRE 2-step verification for logging in, that it'll be mandatory in 6 months. This is unacceptable of course, 2-step is fine for people who are interested in such measures, but for someone secure like me, who keeps their password private and secure and complex, a password is sufficient, especially when the data is too unimportant to be of interest to break in. I'll need to look into how to avoid or disable the stupid requirement. But the Sheets and Docs apps have jumped the gun and are blocking logging in 7 months early! These apps are now completely useless! Any attempt to login pops up a page shoving me towards 2-step, if I close it I'm logged back out.

Way to make this app completely useless. Instant uninstall.

title: Has major Editing Cursor Viewing Issue!
body:
I use this app daily and it is easy to use, pretty to point, nothing too fancy, which is a good thing.

However, it does has a very irritating issue which seems to be missed by the Dev (and the Test team for that matter!) which is when trying to edit long written text, that doesn't all fit on the screen: instead of having the screen stayed at the selected cursor position so you can actually see what you're doing, the moment you hit the backspace button to delete a text, the cursor position get pushed to the most left position of the typing area and stayed there, which rendered the part that you're editing off screen, now you can't see what your deleting nor the new words that you're typing in; you're now typing blind.  

Please fix the issue.  It's a very unintuitive error that seems too obvious to be missed; otherwise, it's a good app.  

Thanks.
